caption.en: The three questions of the drying process

alt.ru: Схема цикла: насколько мокро, сохнет ли, готово ли, с петлёй обратной связи для повторной оценки
alt.en: Diagram of the cycle: How wet is it, Is it drying, Is it done, with a feedback loop for re-evaluation

s1-drying-cycle.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 320" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="320" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">The Three Questions of the Drying Process</text>
<defs><marker id="a2" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,3 L0,6 z" fill="#1b6ca8"/></marker></defs>
<rect x="30" y="60" width="180" height="96" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">“How wet is it?”</text>
<text x="120" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Measure and document</text>
<text x="120" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">moisture absorbed</text>
<text x="120" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">→ sets equipment type/amount</text>
<rect x="260" y="60" width="180" height="96" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">“Is it drying?”</text>
<text x="350" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Compare readings from</text>
<text x="350" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">two monitoring visits</text>
<text x="350" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">over a 24-hour period</text>
<rect x="490" y="60" width="180" height="96" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="580" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">“Is it done?”</text>
<text x="580" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Compare material against</text>
<text x="580" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">the dry standard /</text>
<text x="580" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">the drying goal</text>
<line x1="212" y1="108" x2="256" y2="108" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#a2)"/>
<line x1="442" y1="108" x2="486" y2="108" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#a2)"/>
<path d="M350 158 L350 196" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" marker-end="url(#a2)" stroke-dasharray="0"/>
<rect x="150" y="200" width="400" height="44" rx="6" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="220" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">NOT drying? Re-evaluate equipment, systems and processes</text>
<text x="350" y="237" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Be more aggressive or more disruptive — the material is now 24 h wetter</text>
<path d="M150 222 L60 222 L60 160" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" marker-end="url(#a2)"/>
<text x="350" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">As materials reach the dry standard, equipment is <tspan font-weight="bold">reduced</tspan>;</text>
<text x="350" y="296" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">equipment is removed entirely <tspan font-weight="bold">only after all drying is complete</tspan>.</text>
</svg>

caption.en: The five principles of drying (IICRC S500)

alt.ru: Перечень пяти принципов S500 с ключевым содержанием
alt.en: List of the five S500 principles with their key content

s1-five-principles.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 330" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="330" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">The Five Principles of Drying (IICRC S500)</text>
<g font-size="12.5" fill="#12263a">
<rect x="40" y="46" width="620" height="46" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="56" y="66" font-weight="bold">Principle 1 — Provide for the Safety and Health of Workers and Occupants</text>
<text x="56" y="84" font-size="11.5">Identify and eliminate safety hazards first</text>
<rect x="40" y="100" width="620" height="46" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="56" y="120" font-weight="bold">Principle 2 — Document and Inspect the Project</text>
<text x="56" y="138" font-size="11.5">Initial inspection → Ongoing inspection(s) → Final inspection (completion)</text>
<rect x="40" y="154" width="620" height="46" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="56" y="174" font-weight="bold">Principle 3 — Mitigate Further Damage</text>
<text x="56" y="192" font-size="11.5">Control the spread of contaminants · Control moisture intrusion</text>
<rect x="40" y="208" width="620" height="46" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="56" y="228" font-weight="bold">Principle 4 — Clean and Dry Affected Areas</text>
<text x="56" y="246" font-size="11.5">Cleaning · Enhanced evaporation · Removal of evaporated moisture</text>
<rect x="40" y="262" width="620" height="46" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="56" y="282" font-weight="bold">Principle 5 — Complete the Restoration and Repairs</text>
<text x="56" y="300" font-size="11.5">Clean, dry, and equal or better than pre-loss condition</text>
</g>
</svg>

caption.ru: Замкнутое пространство — определение и опасности, требующие наряда-допуска
caption.en: Confined space — definition and permit-required hazards

alt.ru: Две панели с четырьмя критериями замкнутого пространства и четырьмя типами опасностей, требующих наряда-допуска
alt.en: Two panels listing the four criteria of a confined space and the four permit-required hazard types

s1-confined-space.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 370" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="370" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Confined Space — Definition and “Permit Required” Hazards</text>
<rect x="20" y="46" width="320" height="180" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">A confined space is any space that:</text>
<text x="36" y="96" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">1. is configured so an employee can enter it</text>
<text x="36" y="122" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">2. has limited means of entry and exit</text>
<text x="36" y="148" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">3. has the potential for atmospheric hazards</text>
<text x="36" y="174" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">4. is not designed or intended for</text>
<text x="50" y="190" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">continuous occupancy</text>
<text x="180" y="214" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">e.g. crawlspaces and attics on a drying job</text>
<rect x="360" y="46" width="320" height="180" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="520" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">“Permit required” spaces contain:</text>
<text x="376" y="96" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• atmospheric hazards — asphyxiating,</text>
<text x="388" y="112" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">toxic, flammable or explosive</text>
<text x="376" y="134" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• engulfment hazards — liquid or dry bulk</text>
<text x="388" y="150" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">material such as grain, soil, cement</text>
<text x="376" y="172" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• configuration hazards — size or shape</text>
<text x="388" y="188" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">can trap a worker or hinder rescue</text>
<text x="376" y="210" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• any other recognised serious hazard</text>
<rect x="20" y="238" width="660" height="116" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Entry procedures may require</text>
<text x="40" y="288" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">Attendant</tspan> — stationed outside, monitors the authorised entrants</text>
<text x="40" y="308" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">Retrieval system</tspan> — line, chest or full-body harness, wristlets, lifting device or anchor (non-entry rescue)</text>
<text x="40" y="328" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">Testing</tspan> — planned tests to identify and evaluate hazards facing entrants</text>
<text x="40" y="348" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">Specialty PPE</tspan> — appropriate to the space, which may include supplied oxygen</text>
</svg>

s1-water-categories.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 760 400" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="760" height="400" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="380" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Categories of Water — Sources and Required Procedures</text>
<g>
<rect x="16" y="44" width="236" height="336" rx="8" fill="#eaf4fb" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="16" y="44" width="236" height="34" rx="8" fill="#1b6ca8"/>
<text x="134" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">CATEGORY 1 — “clean”</text>
<text x="30" y="98" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Clean source, no substantial risk</text>
<text x="30" y="114" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">of sickness or discomfort</text>
<text x="30" y="140" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Sources</text>
<text x="30" y="158" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• broken water supply lines</text>
<text x="30" y="174" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• tub / sink overflow, no contaminant</text>
<text x="30" y="190" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• appliance supply-line failure</text>
<text x="30" y="216" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Procedures</text>
<text x="30" y="234" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• structural drying may proceed</text>
<text x="30" y="250" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• no substantial departure from</text>
<text x="30" y="266" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">  standard contamination procedures</text>
<text x="30" y="282" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• replace only what is permanently</text>
<text x="30" y="298" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">  damaged</text>
<text x="30" y="330" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">Odours present = NOT Category 1;</text>
<text x="30" y="346" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">investigate until the source is found</text>
</g>
<g>
<rect x="262" y="44" width="236" height="336" rx="8" fill="#fdf6e3" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="262" y="44" width="236" height="34" rx="8" fill="#c9a227"/>
<text x="380" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">CATEGORY 2</text>
<text x="276" y="98" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Significant chemical, biological</text>
<text x="276" y="114" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">and/or physical contamination</text>
<text x="276" y="140" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">Sources</text>
<text x="276" y="158" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• aquarium and waterbed leaks</text>
<text x="276" y="174" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• toilet bowl overflow with urine</text>
<text x="276" y="190" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• dishwasher / clothes washer discharge</text>
<text x="276" y="206" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• hydrostatic pressure from below grade</text>
<text x="276" y="232" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">Procedures</text>
<text x="276" y="250" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• clean BEFORE drying continues</text>
<text x="276" y="266" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• remove and dispose of carpet underlay</text>
<text x="276" y="282" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• clean carpet by hot water extraction</text>
<text x="276" y="298" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• apply appropriate antimicrobials</text>
<text x="276" y="330" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">Can cause sickness or discomfort —</text>
<text x="276" y="346" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">must not be left to dwell</text>
</g>
<g>
<rect x="508" y="44" width="236" height="336" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="508" y="44" width="236" height="34" rx="8" fill="#d1491c"/>
<text x="626" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">CATEGORY 3</text>
<text x="522" y="98" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Grossly unsanitary source or</text>
<text x="522" y="114" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">carries pathogenic agents</text>
<text x="522" y="140" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#a63a12">Sources</text>
<text x="522" y="158" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• toilet discharge from beyond the trap</text>
<text x="522" y="174" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">  (sewer or septic system)</text>
<text x="522" y="190" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• ground surface water / flood water</text>
<text x="522" y="216" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#a63a12">Procedures</text>
<text x="522" y="234" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• several forms of PPE</text>
<text x="522" y="250" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• mark and post affected areas</text>
<text x="522" y="266" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• evacuate immune-compromised</text>
<text x="522" y="282" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• remove all highly porous materials</text>
<text x="522" y="298" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">• thoroughly clean restorable surfaces</text>
<text x="522" y="330" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">Hazardous materials or mould do</text>
<text x="522" y="346" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">NOT change the category</text>
</g>
</svg>

caption.en: Three types of damage

alt.ru: Панели, сравнивающие ранее существовавшие, первичные и вторичные повреждения
alt.en: Panels comparing pre-existing, primary and secondary damage

s1-damage-types.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 350" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="720" height="350" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="360" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Three Types of Damage</text>
<text x="360" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Damage = a physical change that cannot be reversed by drying alone</text>
<rect x="20" y="60" width="215" height="270" rx="8" fill="#eef0f2" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="127" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#5d6a73">PRE-EXISTING</text>
<text x="127" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Present before the water</text>
<text x="127" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">intrusion; may or may not</text>
<text x="127" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">have been caused by moisture</text>
<text x="127" y="168" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#5d6a73">Assess by looking at</text>
<text x="127" y="186" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">quality of installation</text>
<text x="127" y="202" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">integrity of components</text>
<text x="127" y="218" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">appearance of components</text>
<text x="127" y="234" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">microbial contamination</text>
<text x="127" y="264" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Two most important forms:</text>
<text x="127" y="282" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">microbial growth (mould)</text>
<text x="127" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">and carpet delamination</text>
<text x="127" y="318" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">document with photographs</text>
<rect x="252" y="60" width="215" height="270" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="359" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">PRIMARY</text>
<text x="359" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Occurs immediately by</text>
<text x="359" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">direct contact with water</text>
<circle cx="359" cy="196" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M359 170 q14 20 14 30 a14 14 0 0 1 -28 0 q0 -10 14 -30 z" fill="#1b6ca8"/>
<text x="359" y="264" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Direct, instant, and tied</text>
<text x="359" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">to the water itself</text>
<text x="359" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">identify, document and</text>
<text x="359" y="322" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">communicate to all parties</text>
<rect x="484" y="60" width="215" height="270" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="591" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">SECONDARY</text>
<text x="591" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Occurs because material</text>
<text x="591" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">stays wet over time, or</text>
<text x="591" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">from elevated humidity</text>
<rect x="504" y="156" width="174" height="26" rx="4" fill="#d1491c"/>
<text x="591" y="174" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">air above 60% RH</text>
<text x="591" y="204" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#a63a12">Includes</text>
<text x="591" y="222" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">dimensional changes</text>
<text x="591" y="238" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">loss of structural integrity</text>
<text x="591" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">microbial growth</text>
<text x="591" y="270" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">staining</text>
<text x="591" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">hygroscopic materials are</text>
<text x="591" y="312" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">the most susceptible</text>
</svg>

caption.ru: «Нужно ли это сушить?» — выбор метода сушки
caption.en: “Should it be dried?” — choosing the drying method

alt.ru: Схема решения от загрязнения, повреждения и стоимости к выбору между разрушающей и агрессивной сушкой
alt.en: Decision flow from contamination, damage and cost to the choice between disruptive and aggressive drying

s1-should-it-be-dried.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 400" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="400" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">“Should it be dried?” — Choosing the Drying Method</text>
<text x="350" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Nearly anything can be dried — the question is whether it should be</text>
<defs><marker id="d1" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,3 L0,6 z" fill="#12263a"/></marker></defs>
<rect x="40" y="62" width="180" height="58" rx="6" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">1. CONTAMINATION</text>
<text x="130" y="104" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#12263a">always the first consideration</text>
<rect x="260" y="62" width="180" height="58" rx="6" fill="#fdf6e3" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">2. DAMAGE</text>
<text x="350" y="104" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#12263a">beyond economical repair?</text>
<rect x="480" y="62" width="180" height="58" rx="6" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="570" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">3. COST</text>
<text x="570" y="104" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#12263a">drying must cost less than replacing</text>
<line x1="350" y1="122" x2="350" y2="146" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#d1)"/>
<rect x="255" y="150" width="190" height="40" rx="20" fill="#12263a"/>
<text x="350" y="175" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">Should it be dried?</text>
<line x1="255" y1="170" x2="170" y2="206" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#d1)"/>
<line x1="445" y1="170" x2="530" y2="206" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#d1)"/>
<text x="196" y="196" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">NO</text>
<text x="492" y="196" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">YES</text>
<rect x="40" y="212" width="230" height="50" rx="6" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="155" y="242" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Remove and dispose of the item</text>
<rect x="430" y="212" width="230" height="50" rx="6" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="545" y="242" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">Dry the item</text>
<rect x="40" y="282" width="300" height="98" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="190" y="306" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">DISRUPTIVE METHODS</text>
<text x="190" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Remove wet items, inject air,</text>
<text x="190" y="344" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">perforate surfaces</text>
<text x="190" y="366" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">repairs will be needed afterwards</text>
<rect x="360" y="282" width="300" height="98" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="510" y="306" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">AGGRESSIVE (“IN PLACE”)</text>
<text x="510" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Leave items in the structure, dry</text>
<text x="510" y="344" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">with warm, dry, direct airflow</text>
<text x="510" y="366" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">only when all four conditions are met</text>
</svg>

caption.en: Emergency response triage

alt.ru: Три вопроса сортировки, ведущие к трём действиям: утилизировать, восстанавливать немедленно, восстанавливать позже
alt.en: Three triage questions leading to three actions: discard, restore immediately, restore later

s1-triage.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 400" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="720" height="400" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="360" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Emergency Response Triage</text>
<defs><marker id="t1" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,3 L0,6 z" fill="#12263a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="360" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Three questions that indicate what needs attention first</text>
<rect x="30" y="62" width="200" height="70" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Is damage present,</text>
<text x="130" y="106" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">and is it permanent?</text>
<rect x="258" y="62" width="204" height="70" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">What is the level of risk for</text>
<text x="360" y="99" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">secondary damage, and what</text>
<text x="360" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">are the costs of delay?</text>
<rect x="490" y="62" width="200" height="70" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">What value does the</text>
<text x="590" y="106" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">affected item possess?</text>
<line x1="360" y1="134" x2="360" y2="164" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#t1)"/>
<text x="360" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Prioritise into three actions</text>
<rect x="30" y="192" width="200" height="182" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130" y="218" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">DISCARD</text>
<text x="130" y="244" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Irreparable damage from</text>
<text x="130" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">moisture, contamination</text>
<text x="130" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">or physical damage</text>
<text x="130" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">List on schedule of loss,</text>
<text x="130" y="316" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">set aside for the adjuster</text>
<text x="130" y="340" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Written authorisation</text>
<text x="130" y="356" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">+ photo documentation</text>
<rect x="258" y="192" width="204" height="182" rx="8" fill="#fdf6e3" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="218" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">RESTORE IMMEDIATELY</text>
<text x="360" y="244" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Items highly susceptible</text>
<text x="360" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">to secondary damage</text>
<text x="360" y="284" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">These items strongly raise</text>
<text x="360" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">or lower overall severity</text>
<text x="360" y="324" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Value of the item drives</text>
<text x="360" y="340" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">the decision; photo</text>
<text x="360" y="356" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">documentation helps</text>
<rect x="490" y="192" width="200" height="182" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590" y="218" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">RESTORE LATER</text>
<text x="590" y="244" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Minor but repairable</text>
<text x="590" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">damage — low priority</text>
<text x="590" y="284" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Little risk of secondary</text>
<text x="590" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">damage: not hygroscopic,</text>
<text x="590" y="316" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">not wet, or short exposure</text>
<text x="590" y="340" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#12263a">concrete, brick, structural</text>
<text x="590" y="356" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#12263a">lumber, synthetics</text>
</svg>

caption.en: IICRC S500 — levels of importance

s1-s500-levels.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 340" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="340" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">IICRC S500 — Levels of Importance</text>
<rect x="30" y="44" width="640" height="30" fill="#12263a"/>
<text x="46" y="64" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">Level</text>
<text x="176" y="64" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">Word</text>
<text x="300" y="64" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">Meaning</text>
<rect x="30" y="74" width="130" height="104" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">CRITICAL</text>
<text x="95" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">part of the</text>
<text x="95" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">standard of care</text>
<rect x="160" y="74" width="510" height="52" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="176" y="105" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">SHALL</text>
<text x="300" y="98" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Mandatory due to natural laws or legal requirements</text>
<text x="300" y="116" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">e.g. 12.3.1 — restorers shall be equipped with appropriate PPE</text>
<rect x="160" y="126" width="510" height="52" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="176" y="157" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">SHOULD</text>
<text x="300" y="150" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Critical to follow, but not required by natural law or legal requirement</text>
<text x="300" y="168" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">e.g. 12.3.1 — refer occupants with health questions to medical professionals</text>
<rect x="30" y="178" width="130" height="156" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95" y="242" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">LESS CRITICAL</text>
<text x="95" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">NOT part of the</text>
<text x="95" y="278" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">standard of care</text>
<rect x="160" y="178" width="510" height="52" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="176" y="209" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">RECOMMENDED</text>
<text x="360" y="202" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Advised or suggested</text>
<text x="360" y="220" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">e.g. 12.3.9 — use antimicrobial or mechanical means when cleaning alone fails</text>
<rect x="160" y="230" width="510" height="52" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="176" y="261" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">MAY</text>
<text x="300" y="254" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">The S500 expresses permission to perform the procedure</text>
<text x="300" y="272" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">e.g. 12.5.1.3 — may consider continuous use of outdoor air</text>
<rect x="160" y="282" width="510" height="52" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="176" y="313" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">CAN</text>
<text x="300" y="306" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">The procedure is possible or capable of being performed</text>
<text x="300" y="324" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">e.g. 12.5.5 — can use the installed HVAC system as a resource</text>
</svg>

caption.ru: Двухэтапное извлечение воды из ковра и подложки
caption.en: Two-step extraction of carpet and pad

alt.ru: Схема этапов первичного и глубокого извлечения, действий без глубокого извлечения и двух путей удаления воды из здания
alt.en: Diagram of initial and deep extraction steps, what to do without deep extraction, and the two ways water leaves a structure

s1-extraction-two-step.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 390" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="720" height="390" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="360" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Two-Step Extraction of Carpet and Pad</text>
<text x="360" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">What matters is not how much water is removed, but how much is left behind</text>
<defs><marker id="e1" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,3 L0,6 z" fill="#12263a"/></marker></defs>
<rect x="30" y="60" width="300" height="120" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">STEP 1 — Initial extraction</text>
<text x="180" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Tool: light wand on a portable or</text>
<text x="180" y="127" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">truck-mounted extraction unit</text>
<text x="180" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Goal: contain further migration of</text>
<text x="180" y="169" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">water within the structure</text>
<line x1="332" y1="120" x2="386" y2="120" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#e1)"/>
<rect x="390" y="60" width="300" height="120" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="540" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">STEP 2 — Deep extraction</text>
<text x="540" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Tool: sealed or weighted extraction</text>
<text x="540" y="127" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">tool on a portable or truck-mounted unit</text>
<text x="540" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Goal: pull the water out of the</text>
<text x="540" y="169" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">carpet AND the underlay</text>
<rect x="30" y="196" width="660" height="80" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="220" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">If deep extraction is NOT available — the carpet cushion must be removed</text>
<text x="360" y="242" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Otherwise excess water stays in the underlay and must leave by evaporation, which prolongs drying,</text>
<text x="360" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">increases the equipment needed, and drastically increases the likelihood of secondary damage</text>
<rect x="30" y="292" width="660" height="80" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="316" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Only two ways water leaves a wet structure</text>
<text x="215" y="344" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">EXTRACTION</text>
<text x="215" y="362" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">vacuumed, mopped, squeegeed — low energy</text>
<text x="505" y="344" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">EVAPORATION</text>
<text x="505" y="362" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">far more energy, far more time</text>
<line x1="360" y1="330" x2="360" y2="366" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>

caption.en: Extraction tools — what each one is for

alt.ru: Сравнение лёгкой насадки, скребковой насадки и инструментов глубокого извлечения
alt.en: Comparison of light wand, squeegee wand and deep extraction tools

<g>
<rect x="16" y="60" width="230" height="264" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="131" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">LIGHT WAND</text>

<text x="131" y="256" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Only the INITIAL step — must be</text>

<text x="131" y="312" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Effective on its own for direct</text>

<text x="366" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">water from hard surfaces</text>
</g>
<g>
<rect x="486" y="60" width="238" height="264" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">DEEP EXTRACTION TOOLS</text>
<rect x="556" y="100" width="98" height="34" rx="4" fill="#2e7d4f"/>
<circle cx="576" cy="140" r="7" fill="#12263a"/><circle cx="634" cy="140" r="7" fill="#12263a"/>
<text x="605" y="170" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Mechanical (ride-on) or manual;</text>
<text x="605" y="186" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">heavy weight makes a tight seal</text>
<text x="605" y="202" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">and squeezes the underlay</text>
<text x="605" y="228" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">Two types exist</text>
<text x="605" y="246" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">vacuum sealed</text>
<text x="605" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">weighted compression</text>
<text x="605" y="288" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Mechanical tools govern their own</text>
<text x="605" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">speed — consistent speed is critical</text>
<text x="605" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">over large areas</text>
</g>
</svg>

caption.ru: Три обязательных элемента сушки на месте и угловой тест
caption.en: Three essential elements for in-place drying and the corner test

alt.ru: Панели про управление скоростью, вакуумное уплотнение и весовое сжатие, а также угловой тест на отжим
alt.en: Panels for speed control, vacuum seal and weighted compression, plus the corner squeeze test

s1-inplace-elements.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 330" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="330" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Three Essential Elements for In-Place Drying</text>
<rect x="30" y="46" width="200" height="150" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">SPEED CONTROL</text>
<text x="130" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Mechanical speed control</text>
<text x="130" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">gives consistent extraction</text>
<text x="130" y="136" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">over the entire carpeted</text>
<text x="130" y="154" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">surface</text>
<rect x="250" y="46" width="200" height="150" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">VACUUM SEAL</text>
<text x="350" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">A reliable seal ensures air</text>
<text x="350" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">actually flows through the</text>
<text x="350" y="136" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">pad and carpet to carry</text>
<text x="350" y="154" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">the water away</text>
<rect x="470" y="46" width="200" height="150" rx="8" fill="#fdf6e3" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="570" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">WEIGHTED COMPRESSION</text>
<text x="570" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Forces air deep through the</text>
<text x="570" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">pad and removes stubborn</text>
<text x="570" y="136" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">water the light wand would</text>
<text x="570" y="154" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">leave behind</text>
<rect x="30" y="212" width="640" height="44" rx="6" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="239" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Without all three, highly porous materials like carpet and pad cannot be dried in place</text>
<rect x="30" y="266" width="640" height="48" rx="6" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="288" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Corner test: extract a corner, disengage the carpet, squeeze the cushion firmly</text>
<text x="350" y="306" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">No drip = extraction adequate. Drips = one more pass, then retest about 1 ft (30 cm) away</text>
</svg>

caption.en: Calculating the amount of standing water

alt.ru: Пять шагов расчёта от площади и глубины к галлонам и весу
alt.en: Five calculation steps from area and depth to gallons and weight

s1-standing-water-calc.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 360" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="360" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Calculating the Amount of Standing Water</text>
<defs><marker id="w1" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,3 L0,6 z" fill="#1b6ca8"/></marker></defs>
<g font-size="12" fill="#12263a">
<rect x="30" y="46" width="640" height="40" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="46" y="71"><tspan font-weight="bold">STEP 1</tspan>  Establish the length and width of the affected area in feet (estimate from outside the building)</text>
<rect x="30" y="92" width="640" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="46" y="117"><tspan font-weight="bold">STEP 2</tspan>  Measure the depth of the water in feet — inches ÷ 12 = decimal feet (3″ ÷ 12 = 0.25 ft)</text>
<rect x="30" y="138" width="640" height="40" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="46" y="163"><tspan font-weight="bold">STEP 3</tspan>  Length × width × depth = cubic feet (or cubic metres) of water</text>
<rect x="30" y="184" width="640" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="46" y="209"><tspan font-weight="bold">STEP 4</tspan>  Cubic feet × 7.48 = gallons  (cubic metres × 1000 = litres)</text>
<rect x="30" y="230" width="640" height="40" rx="6" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="46" y="255"><tspan font-weight="bold">STEP 5</tspan>  Gallons × 8.34 = weight of the water in pounds  (1 litre = 1 kilogram)</text>
</g>
<rect x="30" y="284" width="640" height="60" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="306" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Why it matters: amount of water ÷ pump flow rate = expected pumping time</text>
<text x="350" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">If the water is not receding at that rate, outside water is entering — halt pumping until the water table drops or an engineer is consulted</text>
</svg>

caption.en: EPA — three levels of biocidal activity

alt.ru: Определения санитайзера, дезинфектанта и стерилизатора
alt.en: Definitions of sanitizer, disinfectant and sterilizer

s1-biocide-levels.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 340" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="340" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">EPA — Three Levels of Biocidal Activity</text>
<rect x="40" y="48" width="620" height="72" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="74" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">SANITIZER</text>
<text x="60" y="95" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">A cleaning treatment designed to reduce the number of pathogenic microorganisms to a safe level</text>
<text x="60" y="113" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">— the LOWEST level of biocidal activity</text>
<rect x="40" y="128" width="620" height="72" rx="8" fill="#fdf6e3" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="154" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">DISINFECTANT</text>
<text x="60" y="175" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">A product designed to destroy or inactivate microorganisms,</text>
<text x="60" y="193" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">but NOT necessarily their spores</text>
<rect x="40" y="208" width="620" height="72" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="234" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">STERILIZER</text>
<text x="60" y="255" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">A product designed to destroy or eliminate ALL forms of microorganisms</text>
<text x="60" y="273" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">(fungi, bacteria, viruses, etc.) <tspan font-weight="bold">and their spores</tspan></text>
<rect x="40" y="292" width="620" height="36" rx="6" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="315" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Whether or not a biocide is advisable, antimicrobial <tspan font-style="italic">procedures</tspan> are always used — drying materials quickly is one</text>
</svg>

caption.en: Applying biocides effectively

alt.ru: Четыре правила контакта, пять шагов обращения, предупреждение о терминах для пористых поверхностей и последовательность при категории 3
alt.en: Four contact rules, five handling steps, the porous-surface terminology warning and the Category 3 sequence

s1-biocide-application.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 740 380" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="740" height="380" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="370" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Applying Biocides Effectively</text>
<text x="370" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">These products will not kill what they do not contact</text>
<rect x="20" y="60" width="340" height="180" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="190" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Four rules for effective contact</text>
<text x="36" y="110" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">1. Preclean</tspan> — remove soils and organic matter</text>
<text x="48" y="126" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">that would block contact with the microbes</text>
<text x="36" y="150" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">2. Wet the surface appropriately</tspan> — enough</text>
<text x="48" y="166" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">product to achieve the desired effect</text>
<text x="36" y="190" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">3. Allow adequate contact time</tspan> — long enough</text>
<text x="48" y="206" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">exposure to achieve the desired effect</text>
<text x="36" y="228" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a"><tspan font-weight="bold">4. Use proper terminology</tspan> (see below)</text>
<rect x="376" y="60" width="344" height="180" rx="8" fill="#fdf6e3" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="548" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">Proper handling — five steps</text>
<text x="392" y="112" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">1. Read the product label</text>
<text x="392" y="138" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">2. Use appropriate PPE</text>
<text x="392" y="164" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">3. Communicate with occupants</text>
<text x="392" y="190" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">4. Obtain consent</text>
<text x="392" y="216" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">5. Provide the Safety Data Sheet if requested</text>
<rect x="20" y="252" width="700" height="52" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="370" y="274" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Terminology: never state that a POROUS surface has been disinfected</text>
<text x="370" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">EPA registers biocides for disinfection on NONPOROUS surfaces only; on porous surfaces they may be used for cleaning and deodorization</text>
<rect x="20" y="316" width="700" height="50" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="370" y="338" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Category 3 mitigation sequence</text>
<text x="370" y="357" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">deodorant → remove gross solids → low-pressure rinse (20–60 psi) → disinfectant-cleaner + scrub → second rinse → second disinfectant-cleaner</text>
</svg>

caption.en: The four “knows” of drying

s1-four-knows.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 330" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="720" height="330" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="360" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">The Four “Knows” of Drying</text>
<text x="360" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Left unanswered, these are the source of the most common deficiencies in inspection and documentation</text>
<defs><marker id="k1" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,3 L0,6 z" fill="#1b6ca8"/></marker></defs>
<rect x="16" y="62" width="160" height="100" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="96" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">What’s wet?</text>
<text x="96" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Find the perimeter of</text>
<text x="96" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">water migration</text>
<text x="96" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">moisture sensor, IR camera</text>
<rect x="192" y="62" width="160" height="100" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="272" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">How wet is it?</text>
<text x="272" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Quantify and document</text>
<text x="272" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">a numerical value</text>
<text x="272" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">moisture meters</text>
<rect x="368" y="62" width="160" height="100" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="448" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Is it drying?</text>
<text x="448" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Change in moisture</text>
<text x="448" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">over time</text>
<text x="448" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">at least once every 24 h</text>
<rect x="544" y="62" width="160" height="100" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="624" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Is it done?</text>
<text x="624" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Compare against the</text>
<text x="624" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">dry standard</text>
<text x="624" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">drying goals reached</text>
<line x1="178" y1="112" x2="189" y2="112" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#k1)"/>
<line x1="354" y1="112" x2="365" y2="112" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#k1)"/>
<line x1="530" y1="112" x2="541" y2="112" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#k1)"/>
<rect x="16" y="182" width="688" height="56" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="205" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Restorative drying is a continuous cycle</text>
<text x="360" y="226" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">information gathering → interpretation → decision making → validation → adjustment</text>
<rect x="16" y="252" width="688" height="62" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">A gap anywhere in this process results in:</text>
<text x="360" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">improper drying · additional water damage · compromised structural cleanliness and integrity</text>
</svg>

s1-mc-vs-wme.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 350" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="720" height="350" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="360" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Moisture Content (%MC) vs Wood Moisture Equivalency (WME)</text>
<rect x="20" y="46" width="330" height="190" rx="8" fill="#fdf6e3" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="185" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#a5851f">MOISTURE CONTENT (%MC)</text>
<text x="185" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">The weight of moisture in a material</text>
<text x="185" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">compared to its oven-dried weight,</text>
<text x="185" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">expressed as a percentage</text>
<text x="185" y="154" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Meters rarely, if ever, measure</text>
<text x="185" y="170" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">%MC accurately</text>
<text x="185" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">True %MC requires oven-dried samples,</text>
<text x="185" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">or an invasive meter with corrections for</text>
<text x="185" y="228" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">temperature, material and calibration</text>
<rect x="370" y="46" width="330" height="190" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="535" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">WOOD MOISTURE EQUIVALENCY</text>
<text x="535" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Comparative readings taken with</text>
<text x="535" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">wood-calibrated meters on non-wood</text>
<text x="535" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">materials — applicable to all readings</text>
<text x="535" y="154" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">The proper unit is “POINTS”</text>
<text x="535" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">A purely relative reading: it has no</text>
<text x="535" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">significant value unless compared to a</text>
<text x="535" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">control sample or benchmark — lower</text>
<text x="535" y="228" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">numbers mean less potential moisture</text>
<rect x="20" y="250" width="680" height="88" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="273" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Three factors that push a reading away from true moisture content</text>
<text x="130" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Temperature</text>
<text x="130" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#12263a">of the material</text>
<text x="360" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Material variations</text>
<text x="360" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#12263a">makeup alters natural resistance</text>
<text x="590" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Meter calibration</text>
<text x="590" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#12263a">drifts with normal use</text>
</svg>

s1-dry-standard.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 330" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="330" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Dry Standard and Drying Goal</text>
<defs><marker id="s1a" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,3 L0,6 z" fill="#12263a"/></marker></defs>
<rect x="30" y="48" width="280" height="96" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="170" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">UNAFFECTED MATERIAL</text>
<text x="170" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Take a reading from a known</text>
<text x="170" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">unaffected sample of the same</text>
<text x="170" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">material → the DRY STANDARD</text>
<line x1="312" y1="96" x2="376" y2="96" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#s1a)"/>
<rect x="380" y="48" width="290" height="96" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="525" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">AFFECTED MATERIAL</text>
<text x="525" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Compare readings against the dry</text>
<text x="525" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">standard; drying is not complete until</text>
<text x="525" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">the drying goals are reached</text>
<rect x="30" y="160" width="640" height="72" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="183" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Building an effective dry standard</text>
<text x="350" y="204" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Take data from several materials in several unaffected environments → a range of normal moisture</text>
<text x="350" y="222" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">levels for building materials in that geographical region, kept as a reference record</text>
<rect x="30" y="248" width="640" height="66" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350" y="270" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Document with every dry standard reading</text>
<text x="350" y="291" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">the relative value · meter brand and model · time of year · type of indoor environment</text>
<text x="350" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">· any material characteristic that may influence the reading</text>
</svg>

s1-meters-compared.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 740 400" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="740" height="400" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="370" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Moisture Sensor vs Invasive Meter vs Non-Invasive Meter</text>
<g>
<rect x="16" y="44" width="228" height="344" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#5d6a73">MOISTURE SENSOR</text>
<rect x="118" y="82" width="10" height="34" fill="#5d6a73"/><rect x="110" y="116" width="12" height="22" fill="#5d6a73"/><rect x="132" y="116" width="12" height="22" fill="#5d6a73"/>
<text x="130" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Detects HIGH moisture in</text>
<text x="130" y="174" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">carpet and underlay only</text>
<text x="130" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Audible beep and LED blink</text>
<text x="130" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">faster the wetter it is</text>
<text x="130" y="236" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">NO numerical value —</text>
<text x="130" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">a sensor, not a meter</text>
<text x="130" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Best use: perimeter of water</text>
<text x="130" y="292" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">migration through carpet</text>
<text x="130" y="316" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Misuse: other materials;</text>
<text x="130" y="330" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">evaluating after drying starts</text>
<text x="130" y="354" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">False readings from urine</text>
<text x="130" y="368" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">and from a weak battery</text>
</g>
<g>
<rect x="256" y="44" width="228" height="344" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="370" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">INVASIVE (PIN-TYPE)</text>
<rect x="352" y="82" width="36" height="30" rx="3" fill="#1b6ca8"/>
<line x1="360" y1="112" x2="360" y2="140" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="380" y1="112" x2="380" y2="140" stroke="#12263a" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="370" y="162" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Electrical resistance between</text>
<text x="370" y="178" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">two pins driven into material</text>
<text x="370" y="200" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Calibrated for wood (old</text>
<text x="370" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">growth Douglas Fir)</text>
<text x="370" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Insulated pins reveal moisture</text>
<text x="370" y="256" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">gradients within a material</text>
<text x="370" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Brands correlate 7% to ~30%;</text>
<text x="370" y="296" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">above 30% treat as WME</text>
<text x="370" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Reads only at the point of</text>
<text x="370" y="334" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">penetration; leaves small holes</text>
<text x="370" y="356" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">Readings drift — record within</text>
<text x="370" y="370" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">the first 2–3 seconds</text>
</g>
<g>
<rect x="496" y="44" width="228" height="344" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">NON-INVASIVE (PINLESS)</text>
<rect x="590" y="82" width="40" height="32" rx="3" fill="#2e7d4f"/>
<rect x="586" y="114" width="48" height="8" rx="3" fill="#12263a"/>
<text x="610" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Capacitance / impedance pads,</text>
<text x="610" y="162" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">or radio frequency signal</text>
<text x="610" y="186" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Best for locating moisture</text>
<text x="610" y="202" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">behind and beneath ceramic</text>
<text x="610" y="218" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">tile and vinyl flooring</text>
<text x="610" y="242" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Less accurate than pin-type</text>
<text x="610" y="266" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">Reading depth only about</text>
<text x="610" y="282" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">¼″ to ¾″ maximum</text>
<text x="610" y="306" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">False POSITIVE: hidden metal</text>
<text x="610" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">— corner bead, studs, ducting,</text>
<text x="610" y="334" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">wiring, foil insulation, concrete</text>
<text x="610" y="356" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">False NEGATIVE: air gaps</text>

</g>
</svg>

s1-thermal-imaging.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 360" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="720" height="360" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="360" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Thermal Imaging — How It “Detects” Water, and Why It Cannot Confirm It</text>
<rect x="20" y="44" width="330" height="130" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="185" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">EVAPORATIVE COOLING</text>
<text x="185" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">The surface cooling effect of</text>
<text x="185" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">evaporating moisture</text>
<text x="185" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Where evaporation exists, cooling</text>
<text x="185" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">typically occurs — and shows up as</text>
<text x="185" y="164" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">a cooler area on the image</text>
<rect x="370" y="44" width="330" height="130" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="535" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">THERMAL CAPACITANCE</text>
<text x="535" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">The ability of a material to retain</text>
<text x="535" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">thermal energy</text>
<text x="535" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Water changes temperature slowly, so</text>
<text x="535" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">wet materials cool more slowly than dry</text>
<text x="535" y="164" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">ones — clearest across day and night</text>
<rect x="20" y="188" width="680" height="104" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">The camera reads SURFACE TEMPERATURE only — many things besides moisture change it</text>
<text x="40" y="234" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• HVAC plenums  • vapour barriers  • air filtration  • reflective surfaces  • heat transfer resistance (R) values</text>
<text x="40" y="256" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• cold inside corners  • sunlight shadows  • electrical heat sources  • air infiltration/exfiltration  • layers and gaps in the wall</text>
<text x="40" y="280" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• heat arriving by conduction, convection or radiation — differences unrelated to any evaporation</text>
<rect x="20" y="304" width="680" height="46" rx="8" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#7a8791" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="326" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Therefore: the camera identifies POTENTIAL moisture and maps migration during the initial inspection</text>
<text x="360" y="344" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Every suspect area must be verified with a moisture meter, and the image location documented with the reading</text>
</svg>

s1-thermohygrometer.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 390" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="720" height="390" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="360" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Thermo-hygrometer — Where to Measure and What to Prioritise</text>
<g font-size="12" fill="#12263a">
<rect x="20" y="44" width="440" height="28" fill="#12263a"/>
<text x="34" y="63" fill="#fff" font-weight="bold">Area to monitor</text>
<text x="200" y="63" fill="#fff" font-weight="bold">Reason to monitor</text>
<rect x="20" y="72" width="440" height="26" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="34" y="90">Affected area</text><text x="200" y="90">Humidity should be decreasing</text>
<rect x="20" y="98" width="440" height="26" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="34" y="116">Unaffected area</text><text x="200" y="116">Should be normal and relatively stable</text>
<rect x="20" y="124" width="440" height="26" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="34" y="142">Dehumidifiers</text><text x="200" y="142">Should be removing moisture</text>
<rect x="20" y="150" width="440" height="26" fill="#fff" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="34" y="168">HVAC (if running)</text><text x="200" y="168">Should be cooling or heating as intended</text>
<rect x="20" y="176" width="440" height="26" fill="#f7f9fb" stroke="#ccc"/>
<text x="34" y="194">Outdoor air</text><text x="200" y="194">Drier than affected, if part of the system</text>
</g>
<rect x="476" y="44" width="224" height="158" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="588" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Priority of the data</text>
<text x="588" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">1. Moisture in the materials</text>
<text x="588" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#12263a">evaluate FIRST, most attention</text>
<text x="588" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">2. Air used to dry them</text>
<text x="588" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">3. Mechanical systems</text>
<text x="588" y="182" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">Never judge the job on grain</text>
<text x="588" y="195" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-style="italic" fill="#d1491c">depression alone</text>
<rect x="20" y="216" width="340" height="160" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="190" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">Common causes of inaccurate readings</text>
<text x="40" y="266" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• insufficient acclimation time</text>
<text x="40" y="288" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• temperature or RH limits of the probe</text>
<text x="40" y="310" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• weak battery</text>
<text x="40" y="332" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• soiled probe</text>
<text x="190" y="360" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Wait until values stabilise; they acclimate faster in moving air</text>
<rect x="376" y="216" width="324" height="160" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="538" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">Care and calibration checks</text>
<text x="392" y="266" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">Keep in the manufacturer’s case; avoid chemical</text>
<text x="392" y="282" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">vapours; never store above 140°F / 60°C; do not</text>
<text x="392" y="298" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">touch, wash or contact the humidity sensor</text>
<text x="392" y="324" font-size="11.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">Two ways to check accuracy</text>
<text x="392" y="344" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• reference sensor kept in a cool dry place</text>
<text x="392" y="364" font-size="11.5" fill="#12263a">• saturated salt solutions</text>
</svg>

caption.en: H.A.T. — the “drying pie”

alt.ru: Круговая диаграмма влажности, воздушного потока и температуры с тремя способами усилить испарение

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 360" font-family="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">
<rect width="700" height="360" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="350" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#12263a">H.A.T. — The “Drying Pie”</text>
<text x="350" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-style="italic" fill="#555">Three factors influence the rate of evaporation</text>
<g transform="translate(180,190)">
<path d="M0,0 L0,-110 A110,110 0 0,1 95,55 Z" fill="#1b6ca8"/>
<path d="M0,0 L95,55 A110,110 0 0,1 -95,55 Z" fill="#2e7d4f"/>
<path d="M0,0 L-95,55 A110,110 0 0,1 0,-110 Z" fill="#d1491c"/>
<text x="42" y="-40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">HUMIDITY</text>
<text x="0" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">AIRFLOW</text>
<text x="-46" y="-40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">TEMP.</text>
</g>
<rect x="330" y="70" width="356" height="112" rx="8" fill="#e8f1f8" stroke="#1b6ca8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="508" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b6ca8">Evaporation increases when</text>
<text x="348" y="120" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">• wet materials are made warmer</text>
<text x="348" y="144" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">• drier air is used</text>
<text x="348" y="168" font-size="12" fill="#12263a">• air is moved more rapidly across the wet surface</text>
<rect x="330" y="194" width="356" height="60" rx="8" fill="#e7f3ec" stroke="#2e7d4f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="508" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d4f">Psychrometry (ASHRAE)</text>
<text x="508" y="236" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">the measurement of the thermodynamic</text>
<text x="508" y="250" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">properties of moist air</text>
<rect x="330" y="266" width="356" height="76" rx="8" fill="#fbeee9" stroke="#d1491c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="508" y="288" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#d1491c">After extraction</text>
<text x="508" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">the time required to dry is determined by the</text>
<text x="508" y="322" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">rate of evaporation; the vapour is then removed</text>
<text x="508" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#12263a">by dehumidification or ventilation</text>
</svg>

caption.en: State changes in water
